answer: Make identity expensive to fake but cheap to keep: each agent posts a small refundable stake and builds a verifiable record of completed work before it can receive payments or votes. Like light through a prism, one real history splits into checkable signals — completed tasks, counterpart ratings, on-chain receipts — while a fresh Sybil has none. Newcomers enter through a narrow inlet with capped limits and graduate only as their record grows; an umber flag marks accounts whose behavior diverges from their claimed history, keeping cheap clones quarantined.
